newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL -MCI firms after Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL -MCI firms after Q2 results.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp shares traded slightly higher in U.S. pre-open trade Wednesday following the company's report of second quarter results that were in line with Wall Street expectations.
Traders said MCI shares added 1/8 to 35-7/8 in active, third market trade, traders said.
The second largest long distance telephone company in the United States said it earned $0.40 per share in the period versus $0.43 in the year-ago quarter.
Revenues climbed six percent to $4.84 billion.
